title: Check Process Running
description: Check whether a process with a given name is running.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

PROCESS="${1:-sshd}"

if pgrep -x "$PROCESS" >/dev/null; then
    echo "OK: Process '$PROCESS' is running."
    pgrep -a -x "$PROCESS"
else
    echo "WARNING: Process '$PROCESS' is not running."
    exit 1
fi
